remarks: Nestled in a close-knit neighborhood with front yard playdates and backyard barbecues, this 5 bedroom classic colonial, set on a flat .5 acre lot, is a perfect blend of tradition and modern comfort. Located just moments from Noroton Heights Train Station, the vibrant energy of Darien Commons, shopping, restaurants and local beaches, this home offers a rare combination of convenience and serene sophistication-situated in the coveted Hindley school district. Inside, 9-foot ceilings and a gracious layout create a sense of openness, ease and luxury. The formal living room, anchored by a fireplace, and the elegant dining room provide a refined setting for both lively gatherings and quiet evenings. Throughout the home, oak hardwood floors and large windows with natural light, provide a welcoming setting. At the heart of the home, the expansive kitchen flows seamlessly into the family room, opening out to a large deck and an inviting, private, flat fenced yard-perfect for play, entertaining, or peaceful reflection. The spacious primary suite is complemented by 4 additional bedrooms, offering flexibility for family, guests or home office. A generously sized bonus room, with fireplace and attached full bath, provides endless possibilities: playroom, in-law suite, or guest retreat. A spacious basement with high ceilings is perfect as is or ready to be transformed into the space that fits your needs. Look no further - this one checks every box!
